text:
priya-peopleops: Hey @alex-eng-manager — prepping a compact manager checklist for Jamie's first week. Can you confirm these items look right? Quick items:
- day0: provisioning (laptop, acct, VPN)
- day1: intros + team stand + 2hr setup block
- day2: onboarding tasks + env runbook pairing
- day3: shadow production run + first small ticket
- day4: 1:1 + career expectations chat
Also including a short 30/60/90 template and who-to-ask list below. :wave:

alex-eng-manager: Looks good, thanks. A couple questions: can we add a 1hr API walkthrough and an expectation that they ship a small PR in week1? Also, do you have a minimal 30/60/90 I can hand to them?

priya-peopleops: Absolutely. Added API walkthrough to day2 morning and PR expectation to day3. Pasting a tiny 30/60/90 you can share: 

```
30 days: get dev env green, complete 2 onboarding tasks, meet cross-functional partners
60 days: own 1 small feature end-to-end, reduce review turnaround for assigned area
90 days: lead a postmortem or ship a meaningful perf/infra improvement
```

And here's a suggested first-week calendar snippet you can copy to invites: 
```
Mon day1: 10:00 all-hands intro, 11:30 team stand, 13:00 setup block (IT + VPN)
Tue day2: 09:30 API walkthrough (eng pair), 14:00 env pairing + runbook
Wed day3: 10:00 shadow production + small PR workblock
Thu day4: 09:00 cross-team sync, 15:00 1:1 with manager
Fri day5: 11:00 team sync + retro on onboarding
```
Who-to-ask quick list: IT (hardware & MDM) = @it-support, Security = @sec-ops, Workspace + perks = @people-ops, Repo access = @eng-infra.

alex-eng-manager: Perfect, I'll send calendar invites now. One more: Jamie is in PST — should we shift some onboarding to later in the day?

jamie-newhire: Thanks — excited to start! Quick Q: laptop ETA? and I don't yet have access to the monorepo (403 on clone). My timezone is PST (UTC-8). Also, is there a Slack channel for new hires? :slightly_smiling_face:

onboard-bot: Welcome Jamie! :tada: Your account was created. Quick links: https://redwood.internal/onboarding-setup, https://redwood.internal/it-requests. If you need hardware, reply with "hardware request" and we'll route it.

priya-peopleops: Jamie — hardware request received, IT will DM ETA (usually 2-4 business days). For the repo 403, ping @eng-infra with your GitHub username and I'll escalate. Channel for new joiners is #new-hires — added you. I'll also move a few onboarding sessions to 14:00 PST to keep them within overlap windows. :thumbsup:

alex-eng-manager: Thanks everyone. I'll send invites for the adjusted times and include the tiny 30/60/90 as the expectations doc. cc @jamie-newhire — pairing session booked Tue 14:00 PST.

jamie-newhire: Awesome, thanks all. See you Tuesday! :party_parrot:
